cluster.notes: Qualitative clustering from mandate + body-tier feed titles; top candidates: Polymarket/Maduro (19 items), Marijuana reclassification (16), Lebanon ceasefire (16), Meta layoffs (10), Spirit Airlines (9), Warner Bros/Paramount (10), Intel AI (5), DeepSeek V4 (8).

select.notes: Intel AI earnings (mandate_count=2 via Bloomberg+FT, Markets) initially selected as lead but dropped — all Intel body-tier URLs (Reuters GN, Semafor GN) unreachable through the blocked egress and FT is headline-only. Warner Bros/Paramount $110B merger and Spirit Airlines taxpayer takeover evaluated for slot 5 but dropped on the 2-body-source minimum. Edition ships 4/5.

research.notes: Direct outlet URLs worked intermittently: NPR, PBS, CBS, Fox, NBC. gap_note: 4/5 stories: slot 5 dropped after Intel (Markets), Warner Bros/Paramount (Business), and Spirit Airlines (Business) each failed the Step 7 minimum of 2 body-tier sources due to egress-blocked outlets (Reuters via Google News, FT, BBC, The Hill, CNBC, Bloomberg via Google News).
